models.inverse_notes: Let r6 be known in[0,1]. Additive numerator inverses U=r6*(LF+A)-A-P and P=r6*(LF+A)-A-U are unique with other counts known and original guards retained. LF=(U+A+P)/r6-A requires r6!=0; recovered LF>=U+P and LF+A>0. A=(r6*LF-U-P)/(1-r6) requires r6!=1 and A>=0; retain all guards. Roster substitution r6=7/12,LF10,A2,P3 recovers U2 and forward7/12. Same rate U2,LF10,P3 recovers A2, forward7/12. At r6=1, consistency requires LF=U+P and any A>=0 with LF+A>0 fits, so A unidentified. At r6=0, nonnegative inputs force U=A=P0 and any LF>0 fits; LF unidentified. r6=0 with positive numerator impossible. No roots. Recovery does not identify unobserved individual classifications or establish a causal labor response.
limitations: Not the official U-3 unemployment rate; no forecasts, policy ranking, unemployment-probability or equilibrium claims.

Scalar aggregate guards cannot verify subgroup membership, eligibility, common survey weights or actual hours/search answers. Rounded observations introduce arithmetic discrepancies separate from survey sampling uncertainty.

relationship.original_equation: U-6 percent = 100*(unemployed + marginally attached + at work part time for economic reasons)/(civilian labor force + marginally attached).
relationship.translation_notes: Introduced U,LF,A,P,r6 map source named counts and U-6 fractional rate. Remove source percent multiplier100 to serialize fraction. Dimensions (person+person+person)/(person+person)=1. P is already within LF, so denominator LF+A contains P once; numerator's U,A,P are disjoint classifications. Require U+P<=LF, nonnegative inputs and LF+A>0. A is outside LF within same eligible population; membership cannot be proved from aggregate scalar inputs and is a required contextual condition. LF0,A>0 is a valid limiting eligible subgroup: U=P0 gives r6=1, without inventing an LF>0 restriction. U-5 is the same value only in an actually observed population with P0; U-3 only when A=P0. Do not fabricate those zero groups to claim a broader rate equals unemployment.

sources.evidence: U-6 counts unemployed, marginally attached and involuntary part-time workers relative to labor force plus marginal attachment.
